name: Wilhelm van Astrea
japaneseName: ヴィルヘルム・ヴァン・アストレア
description: Wilhelm van Astrea, formerly Wilhelm Trias and famously known as the Sword Demon, is a master swordsman and butler serving Crusch Karsten within the Crusch Camp. The widower of former Sword Saint Theresia van Astrea, he dedicated fourteen years to hunting down the White Whale, playing a decisive role in its defeat in Arc 3 and later defending Priestella in Arc 5.
